Unchecked consumer of the selected index.

facts.rationale: Adds useful exceptional-path and attribute-validity knowledge absent from the normal weighted-selection explanation, without asserting an actual runtime out-of-bounds failure or a particular attribute allocation.
facts.value: The weighted selector initializes its result to -1 and stops searching after a match or after x4_length entries. It reads x8[0] unconditionally and adds x8[i + 1].x0_odds at the end of every executed search iteration, including an iteration that has already selected a result. It has no local validation of length, weights, total-weight arithmetic, or the resulting index. Its constructor caller immediately uses the returned value as an attribute-array index to obtain damage.
